definitions.gloss: fed up, sick and tired, disgusted
definitions.explanation: Feeling weary or annoyed from too much of something.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{同|おな}じ{仕事|しごと}でうんざりする。
examples.english: I'm fed up with the same work every day.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{言|い}い{訳|わけ}にはうんざりだ。
うんざりするほど{待|ま}たされた。
examples.english: I was made to wait until I was fed up.

notes: Expresses exhaustion or disgust from repetition or excess. Often used with する or as うんざりだ. Similar to {飽|あ}きる (to get tired of) but with more negative feeling.
